suite.name: CB Suite
suite.notes: Adds Reference - Aspire: install it from the Apps page. Aspire's API status now also watches the parts of Aspire that Reference reads.

dashboard.name: CB Dashboard
dashboard.notes: First official release. The office TVs each show a page from Aspire: Route Completion, Snow Event, Shop Status, Equipment Requests, Weather or Welcome. Pick each screen's page, layout and display mode in Settings → Displays. A TV moved to another port keeps its page. On the computer that runs the TVs, turn on Open at sign-in and Keep screens awake. The Snow Event board no longer treats spring plow-damage repairs as a storm, and its last storm is always one where snow work was actually done.

requests.name: Equipment Requests - Aspire
requests.notes: First official release. Turns equipment requests from the field into repair tickets on the Equipment Repairs route. Each ticket gets a repair card the mechanic sees in Aspire Mobile, and there's a schedule of the repair route. If a ticket ends up with no repair card, it shows at the top of the list on every computer: pick the request it's for and the app attaches its card. The app also stops before making a second ticket for a request that may already have one.

photos.name: Property Photos - Aspire
photos.notes: First official release. Field photos by property or ticket, with a satellite map of each property. Photos download only when you open them and are kept for a week. Map pieces are kept for 30 days.

reference.name: Reference - Aspire
reference.notes: First release. Things in Aspire that are slow to look up one at a time, as lists you can search, sort, filter and save as CSV. It covers property square feet, notes and contacts; contracts ending and open bids; equipment asset numbers, plates and renewals, and the service log. It also lists records in Aspire that are missing something. It only reads Aspire — it never changes anything.
